presentation.label: MANGLE
presentation.summary: A delay whose repeats get crushed, pulsed or shimmered a little more on every pass.
presentation.overview: Mangle is a feedback delay with three mutations you can blend. Crush degrades each repeat and Tremolo makes it pulse, both inside the feedback so they compound with every pass; Pitch adds an octave-down grain shimmer to the output. With all three at 0 it is a clean delay.
highlights: Crush and Tremolo compound with every repeat
All three at 0 is a clean delay
usage: Put Mangle in a patch: with Crush, Tremolo and Pitch at 0 it is a clean delay.
Set Time and Feedbk, then raise Crush, Tremolo or Pitch to change every repeat.
Mix blends the repeats with your dry signal.

access.location: The pedal's effect list, Delay group, as Mangle.
steps: Add Mangle to a patch from the effect list (Delay group).
Its knobs are on the effect's pages, three per page.

controls.name: Time
controls.doc: Delay length, about 23 ms to 1.3 s.

controls.name: Crush
controls.doc: Degradation in the feedback (sample-rate reduction, bit crush, darkening); 0 = off.

controls.name: Tremolo
controls.doc: An amplitude wobble of about 4.5 Hz in the feedback, so repeats pulse harder each pass; 0 = off.

controls.name: Pitch
controls.doc: Octave-down grain shimmer on the output; 0 = off.

limitations: Built with the init path off: a recalled patch plays the knobs' defaults until you touch a knob.

load.conditions: The cost Mangle declares in its descriptor, which the pedal adds up per patch; not read from the DSP meter.

hardware.summary: The release file was installed over USB and read back identical; after a power cycle the pedal booted with the effect installed.
limitations: One run, reported by the tester; nothing measured. The report covers the boot and the effect being installed, not its sound or its knobs.
Built with the init path off: the sound takes saved knob values only once a knob is touched.
MIDISTOMP V2.0.1 on Zoom's 2.10, not Zoom's 2.10 alone.

tests.summary: The release file has no code from Zoom's effects (check_no_stock.py), passes Ziddle's loader check, renders in Ziddle, and booted installed on an MS-70CDR.
